rules: Settings uses canonical tool_id values and never creates a parallel tool catalogue.
Settings may disable tools and raise confirmation requirements, but cannot force-enable unavailable tools.
Settings cannot expand supported_roles, raise autonomy ceilings, bypass cost/entitlement policy, or disable runtime-required confirmation.
Tool identity, role support, discovery visibility, provider availability, entitlement and cost eligibility do not grant execution authority.
Every execution still requires runtime authority, approval/risk/autonomy checks and the governed execution boundary.
company_id is the sole company boundary; legacy tenant aliases are rejected.
